findings.claim: Same key after 5xx replays Stripe's stored 500 for 24h -> payout ends manual after 5 attempts.
findings.evidence: Stripe idempotency stores status+body incl. 500; refunds.mjs:10-12 relies on it; fake never stores injected errors.
findings.fix: Keep key only after no response/409/429; after received 5xx take-over then bump key; fake replays stored errors; test 5xx then success -> one transfer.

findings.claim: Strict state_as_of guard compares Stripe event.created with local clock; skew can reject a newer ready event permanently.
findings.evidence: Spec Account state sync asOf sources.
findings.fix: Do not compare clocks: webhook only orders events / flags resync; retrieval always applied; skew test.

findings.claim: Pending accounts are never re-read without webhook or mentor revisit; Connect secret optional -> money held forever.
findings.evidence: OQ3 unset -> no account.updated; page syncs only on return/refresh; job resyncs only flagged accounts.
findings.fix: Periodic job resync of pending accounts with owed money; sync on every visit; DB test without webhook.

findings.claim: Webhook refund_seen_at predicate includes failed refunds, refunds.list check excludes them -> failed dashboard refund cancels earned money.
findings.evidence: OQ10 vs Stripe refunds check; webhook.mjs:84-86 handles refund.failed.
findings.fix: One predicate: amount_refunded>0 or refund status pending/requires_action/succeeded; test.

findings.claim: FOR UPDATE on mentors across accounts.create blocks FK inserts of requests up to ~60s, contradicting R13.
findings.evidence: 0006 requests.mentor_id FK; FOR KEY SHARE conflicts with FOR UPDATE; stripe-client timeout 20s x3.
findings.fix: pg_advisory_xact_lock or FOR NO KEY UPDATE.

findings.claim: Transfers-only Express account in PL may require recipient service agreement.
findings.evidence: Stripe capability docs; Express examples request card_payments+transfers.
findings.fix: Request card_payments+transfers or set service agreement; record in OQ2.

findings.claim: Lease 5 min not >> SDK budget: four sequential calls per attempt up to ~4 min.
findings.evidence: Payout job step 4; stripe-client maxNetworkRetries 2, timeout 20s.
findings.fix: Longer lease or remaining-lease check before create.

findings.evidence: Spec line 105 vs OQ7; draft MentorPayouts.tsx:27.
findings.fix: Add cancelled and ready/not-ready held variants with stories.
